blocks.text: Btrfs profiles use the configured filesystem and subvolume layout. Filesystem allocation, metadata usage and ordinary file sizes are different measurements. Use Computer Management → System & Recovery → Maintenance & Health → Storage & Filesystems for the configured views.

Use the managed Btrfs usage and scrub-status views. Scrub verifies readable data against checksums; it is not a backup and does not repair every kind of failure. Deleted files can remain referenced by snapshots.

Do not run balance, device removal, subvolume deletion or repair commands copied from another host. Preserve independent backups and get a recovery plan before operations that rewrite filesystem metadata.
